findings.title: Recheck current Human authority before physical retry and recovery
findings.trigger: An original Run already has cancel_requested=true; revoke or expire the local Human technical_owner assignment, then make a new /api/agent-runs/<run>/cancel or /recover POST with the still-valid workbench session.
findings.observed_code: cancelled() checks original Human identity and the historical cancel_requested flag only. retryCancellation()/recover() call physical ports. Kernel.getObject() is a read query without assignment authorization. The new Kernel.authorizeAgentRunControl() requires a current technical_owner, but the parent control path never calls it. The child control path does call it.
findings.impact: A Human who no longer has the control role can request a new original Native cancellation marker or resource recovery. A past authorized cancellation is used as continuing authority for a new Human physical operation.

standards.rule: Each formal action must have Actor, acting role, scope and authorization basis; missing roles do not implicitly expand authority; assignment permissions have scope/actions/effective time.
Revoked authority preserves history but prohibits new Commands; Adapter/Runtime cannot expand authority.

findings.validation: Static end-to-end call tracing only; no test or Native operation executed.
findings.recommendation: Use Kernel.authorizeAgentRunControl for parent physical operations and recheck it at relevant await/effect boundaries, as child control does. Keep historical query and collection separately read-only.

findings.title: Pin the HTTP request path to the original approved connection
findings.trigger: An installed account/credential/network hook changes the public runtime boundary.path after createDedicatedAgentRuntimeModel has checked its initial path. This requires trusted JavaScript callback mutation; no ordinary UI/model payload setter was found.
findings.observed_code: GatewayNetworkBoundary constructor assigns readonly path as a normal runtime property. The immutable DNS pin includes the original path. Dedicated model checks boundary.path only at creation (line 69), then awaits installed hooks. consumeHttpConnection checks socket/peer/cert/expiry but not path; HTTPS POST later reads current boundary.path (line 168).
findings.impact: The request may go to a different provider endpoint while the account/budget hold remains bound to the original connection_digest. Static finding is conditional on trusted callback drift, so it is advisory rather than a demonstrated normal-input authorization bypass.

standards.rule: Permissions are limited by scope/actions/effective period; Runtime may not expand authority.
Applicability must bind exact necessary environment/configuration dimensions; do not associate mismatching configuration results with the current claim.

findings.validation: Static property and async call-chain inspection only; no requests or credentials accessed.
findings.recommendation: Capture an immutable approved path for the transport and compare it with the owned pin when the socket is consumed. Avoid reading a replaceable public property at send time.
